-- November 2025 tickets and how long they took to close
SELECT
  ticket_id,
  priority,
  ROUND(julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at), 1) AS hours_to_close
FROM support_tickets
WHERE opened_at BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-11-30'
ORDER BY ticket_id;
solution:
SELECT
  ticket_id,
  priority,
  ROUND((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24, 1) AS hours_to_close
FROM support_tickets
WHERE opened_at >= '2025-11-01'
  AND opened_at < '2025-12-01'
ORDER BY ticket_id;
